tip: Force the use of IPv4 addresses only.
Force the use of IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: -a
tip: Continue interrupted transfers instead of overwriting existing files.
If the partial contents differ, the result is likely corrupt.

option.name: -A
tip: Allow forwarding of the ssh-agent to the remote system.
The default is not to forward an authentication agent.

option.name: -b
tip: Read a series of commands from a batch file instead of stdin.
Use with non-interactive authentication to avoid a password prompt.

option.name: -B
tip: Specify the size of the transfer buffer.
Larger buffers reduce round trips at the cost of memory; the default is 32768 bytes.

option.name: -c
tip: Select the cipher for encrypting the data transfer.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -C
tip: Enable compression by passing -C to ssh.

option.name: -D
tip: Connect directly to a local sftp server instead of via ssh.
A command and its arguments may be given, for example /path/sftp-server -el debug3.

option.name: -f
tip: Request that files be flushed to disk immediately after transfer.
Uploads only when the server implements the fsync@openssh.com extension.

option.name: -F
tip: Specify an alternative per-user configuration file for ssh.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -i
tip: Select the identity (private key) file for public key authentication.
This option is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -J
tip: Connect to the target host through the given jump host.
Multiple jump hops may be separated by commas.
This is a shortcut for ProxyJump and is directly passed to ssh.

option.name: -l
tip: Limit the used bandwidth, specified in Kbit/s.

option.name: -N
tip: Disable quiet mode, overriding the implicit quiet mode set by -b.

option.name: -o
tip: Pass options to ssh in the format used in ssh_config(5).
Useful for options that have no separate sftp command-line flag.
See ssh_config(5) for the options and their values.

option.name: -p
tip: Preserve modification times, access times, and modes from the original files.

option.name: -P
tip: Set the port to connect to on the remote host.

option.name: -q
tip: Quiet mode: disable the progress meter and the warning and diagnostic messages from ssh.

option.name: -r
tip: Recursively copy entire directories.
Symbolic links are not followed.

option.name: -R
tip: Specify how many requests may be outstanding at once.
The default is 64.

option.name: -s
tip: Specify the SSH2 subsystem or the path to an sftp server on the remote host.
A path is useful when the remote sshd has no sftp subsystem configured.

option.name: -S
tip: Specify the program used for the encrypted connection.
The program must understand ssh options.

option.name: -v
tip: Raise the logging level.
This option is also passed to ssh.

option.name: -X
tip: Specify an option that controls SFTP protocol behaviour.
Valid options: nrequests=<value> for concurrent requests (default 64) and buffer=<value> for the buffer size (default 32KB).
